expression.expression:
CASE
  WHEN close_price > ma_200
    THEN 'Above MA'
  WHEN close_price < ma_200
    THEN 'Below MA'
  ELSE 'At MA'
END
LAG(Close) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY Date)
w.ticker = b.ticker AND w.trade_year = b.trade_year AND w.Date = b.last_date

fileTabs.content:
SELECT
        ticker,
        Date,
        ROUND(Close, 2) AS close_price,
        ROUND(AVG(Close) OVER (
          PARTITION BY ticker
          ORDER BY Date
          ROWS BETWEEN 199 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ), 2) AS ma_200,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
          PARTITION BY ticker
          ORDER BY Date
          ROWS BETWEEN 199 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS days_in_window
      FROM ma_filtered

expression.expression:
CASE
  WHEN avg_daily_pct_change > 0
    THEN 'Gain'
  WHEN avg_daily_pct_change < 0
    THEN 'Loss'
  ELSE 'Flat'
END
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY percent_gain DESC)
w.ticker = b.ticker AND w.trade_year = b.trade_year AND w.Date = b.first_date
